heroHeadline: ICE Sharpens Interior Enforcement Through State and Local Cooperation Deals
heroSubtitle: A new report documents ICE sharply increasing arrests in homes, neighborhoods, and workplaces after striking cooperation agreements with state and local officials. Critics say the agreements were sold under false pretenses, raising concerns about the transparency and scope of interior enforcement operations.
